$comment: User-agent tokens (letters, digits, hyphens only; matched case-insensitively). next.config.js adds both lists to Next's default htmlLimitedBots so these crawlers get a fully rendered page instead of the PPR shell. proxy.ts also sends Cache-Control: private, no-store to aiCrawlers so their full render never lands in the CDN cache. The Cloudflare 'Bypass cache for AI bots' rule must list the same aiCrawlers (docs/incidents/2026-04-24-ai-bot-cdn-cache-mix.md).
